summary.name: Shop Guru AI
summary.one_liner: An AI online shopping assistant that researches, compares, and ranks products across multiple retailers based on a plain-language description.
keywords: amazon best buy walmart target search
use_cases: Finding deals on Amazon, Best Buy, Walmart, or Target
Summarizing customer reviews for a product
Ranking products by value and quality
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a tool where the user types a description of any product and the AI searches multiple retailers, named as Amazon, Best Buy, Walmart, Target, and more. It says the AI analyzes reviews, specs, and pricing to rank products by relevance, value, and overall quality. Results are said to include match scores, value ratings, and reasoning explaining each ranking. The directory listing describes it as analyzing customer reviews to give answers based on specific product information.
notable: Searches multiple named retailers (Amazon, Best Buy, Walmart, Target) from one query
Shows match scores, value ratings, and reasoning for each ranking
AI analysis of reviews, specs, and pricing
caveats: Pricing not stated on the page; the directory listing tags it #free but this is not confirmed by the page itself
Retailer list is partial ('and more'), so coverage is not fully specified
